comment: The Distinct tolerance is 0.001V (stats.cpp:118, the default argument of isDistinct), where the readme says 0.0001V. The jack the panel labels Sort is configured as "Ascending". The Mode calculation only counts values that are bit-for-bit equal (stats.cpp:219 uses ==), so voltages that merely look the same are not grouped. Ranges were left off the statistical outputs because they follow whatever is patched in; only Count has a range of its own.
